title: Broker manifest
description: The allowlist. default is the constant deny: an action absent from actions, an actor absent from grants, or a tier above the grant's max_tier is refused. mode shadow records decisions without enforcing them. approvers is the allowlist of identities (issuer and subject, matched exactly; self-approval and the agent rule compare normalized) whose approvals count; without it no approval is accepted. An approver of kind agent, or one whose subject names a granted profile, counts only when allow_agent_approvers is true. approval_ttl_s defaults to 900 when absent. 1.1 adds approvers and allow_agent_approvers. 1.2 adds, additively, lanes (write lanes the broker's built-in lane handler writes into: kind files or records-inbox, a root under the data root, per-actor subdirectories, a filename pattern, a size cap, a format and an optional content schema, exclusive create unless overwrite), an action's optional lane (its handler is then builtin/lane) and handler_docs (the handler documents, relative to the manifest, that pin each exec handler's digest). 1.3 adds, additively, the transport identities: callers (a peer, by numeric uid or user name, mapped to the one profile it acts as; a peer not listed is refused), approval_relays (peers trusted to carry a human approver's identity for one issuer; the approvers rules still apply) and dev_identity (whether the CLI's asserted --as identity is accepted; absent means false). 1.4 adds, additively, refusal_limit: how many refused requests one transport peer (a caller or an unknown peer; approval relays are exempt) may collect per window before the socket answers it rate-limited for the rest of the window, audited once per window; absent means 60 per 60 s. 1.5 adds, additively, quotas on accepted work: quotas.pending_per_actor (how many requests one actor may have pending at once; a submit past it is refused too-many-pending; absent means 20) and quotas.notify_window_s (an actor's approval requests page the approver at most once per window, the page counting the actor's pending requests; absent means 300 s), and a lane's max_files and max_total_bytes (what one lane directory may hold; absent means 4096 files and 64 MiB). 1.6 adds, additively, a shared lane's per-actor share (max_files_per_actor and max_bytes_per_actor: what one actor's own files in a per_actor false lane may come to; absent means an eighth of the lane's max_files and max_total_bytes) and a lane's max_writes_per_hour (files one actor may write into the lane directory per hour, refused lane-rate-exceeded past it; absent means 120 on a shared lane and no limit on a per-actor one); an actor's approval requests page only while it has no open page, quotas.notify_window_s apart at least; and max_files may be null (no file cap: an append-only lane).

lane.description: The lane this action writes into; its handler is then builtin/lane and its tier write (checked by hnx broker validate).

handler_docs.description: Handler documents (schemas/broker/handler), relative to the manifest file.

root.description: Directory under the broker's data root.

per_actor.description: Write into <root>/<actor's profile slug>/ (default true for files; a records-inbox lane is shared).

filename_pattern.description: Regular expression the whole file name must match.

content_schema.description: <dir>/<name> of a packaged schema the JSON content must satisfy.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file atomically; default false (exclusive create).

max_files.description: 1.5: the most files the lane's target directory (the actor's own for per_actor, else the lane's) may hold; a write past it is refused lane-quota-exceeded. Absent: 4096. 1.6: null sets no file cap, for an append-only lane (findings) bounded by max_total_bytes and max_writes_per_hour instead.

max_total_bytes.description: 1.5: the most bytes the lane's target directory may hold, the new file included; absent: 67108864 (64 MiB).

max_files_per_actor.description: 1.6, a shared lane (per_actor false) only: the most files of one actor's the lane directory may hold (a records-inbox file is the actor's by its name and tag; a files lane keeps an owner index); a write past it is refused lane-quota-exceeded. Absent: max_files / 8.

max_bytes_per_actor.description: 1.6, a shared lane only: the most bytes of one actor's files the lane directory may hold, the new file included. Absent: max_total_bytes / 8 (at least max_bytes).

max_writes_per_hour.description: 1.6: files one actor may write into the lane directory in any hour; a write past it is refused lane-rate-exceeded. Absent: 120 on a shared lane, no limit on a per-actor lane.

callers.description: Who may connect as an agent: each peer maps to exactly one profile, which is the actor of everything it asks for. The request body never names the actor.

uid.description: Numeric user id of the connecting process (SO_PEERCRED).

user.description: User name, resolved to a uid when the service starts.

approval_relays.description: Peers that may file approvals and denials for a human they authenticated, for one issuer (e.g. the hub behind the SSO front door). The approver allowlist, self-approval and agent-approver rules still apply.

uid.description: Numeric user id of the connecting process (SO_PEERCRED).

user.description: User name, resolved to a uid when the service starts.

dev_identity.description: Accept the CLI's asserted --as identity (local development only). Absent means false.

refusal_limit.description: 1.4: the socket transport's per-peer limit on refused requests (every answer but ok, whatever its kind, except the broker's own faults). Over max refusals within window_s seconds, the peer is answered rate-limited until the window ends, with one audit record per window. Absent: max 60, window_s 60.

quotas.description: 1.5: per-actor quotas on accepted operations. pending_per_actor: requests one actor may have pending (submitted, not yet run, cancelled, denied or decided) at once; absent 20. notify_window_s: the least time between two of an actor's approval pages (0: none); absent 300. 1.6: an actor pages only while it has no open page, and a page the window holds back is sent when it passes.
